title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Dealing with a wife who has separated from husband without husband's consent and taking away the kids 3530 views Q. What are the rulings of having walima? How soon after the meeting of the bride & groom should walima be held? 14853 views Q. Assalam Alaikum, My son's Nikkah has been fixed, and to avoid unwanted expenses we would like to do the Valima soon after the Nikkah. My relative adviced to do the Valima 15 minutes after the Nikkah during this period Bride and Groom should meet together. 1. Please advice is there any time duration limit between Nikkah and Valima? 2. If so what are the formalities to be completed? Your immediate response shall be highly appreciated in this regard. Wassalam. 3666 views Q. Assalamwalaikum, I am the only son to my parents and have one sister, who is married and living seperately. There are differences between my wife and my parents because of which my wife wants me to work in gulf so that we can live together and she wants me to leave my parents at my sister's place. BUT I want to stay with my parents and I just cannot think of living without them.. My wife just does not feel comfortable staying with my parents she feels very lonely. My wife herself recommends for my second marriage What should I do and how should I live with both of them? My second question is My parents like my wife's sister Can I get married to her itself? 2855 views Q. Nikah 2112 views Q. I have pronounced talaq thice (at one go) to my wife in pressure because of her uncle over the phone. there were no witness and I went back to my wife within the iddah period and told her that she is till my wife and I want to take her back. Is she still in my nikah 3257 views Q. I am going to get married soon in-sha-Allah, but I have a doubt about the mahr 2744 views Q. I have two question: 1) I heard that if u do not have sex before walima then its food is haram. 2) If wife is passing from monthly periods and not agree for this can i do it forcefully. 102118 views Q. I am a Sunni Muslim i want to marry a Shia girl.MY father is ready with this but my mother and her sisters are not ready with this,as They think that shia's have different lifestyle and will not be able to adjust,Secondly the major question which at times Knocks me too,is shia muslim prioritize Hazrat Ali (R.A) over Prophet Mohammed (S.A.W) and disrespect/disagree or Khalifas Hazrat Abu Bakr siddique (R.A)and hazrat Omar (R.A).. Does she need to change her practices and her perspective .. What all the grounds on which i should make her understand and decide on marrying her. Further i am the one who has proposed her,and promised that everyone will agree to our decision,but know if i turn back saying that marrying her is not jaiz/allowed, will i not be held responsible for betraying her in the eyes of sharia. I,hereby request you to sujjest me the best possible way to come out from this and take decision which leads success in this life and hereafter. 5130 views Q. My younger Nephew & Niece are young and on the age of marriage, my family has seen some boys in other family location 30 K.Ms away one is doing job and other is student. One boy is my Mama's son (cousion) and other is my Cousion son. Now both of them has refused to say yes or no for marriage. But learnt that one who is doing job has engaged with some other one. My question is that either we have continue our family terms or we cut off the family terms or wait till the 2nd relative may give us any answer. Thanks 1568 views Q. Assalamu Allaikaum (1) Is it is allowed in any circumstance for a Muslim girl to marry a Hindu boy. If the girl is very obedient and done nothing bad in her past for her parents and except talking, (2) she is not more engaged with that boy. But she had made committment.. What parents can do? (3) of course She will marry with the body who will be selected by their parents, then what about the only request made by so obedient girl from her parents in whole life? 2542 views Q. Can One Marry Her Own Step-Sister? 9993 views Q. My name is Mohammed Safiullah from Bangalore, India. Kindly let me know the Fatwa in the light of Quran and Sunnah 3266 views Q. My wife kisses my breast and also sucks it is that right? 12259 views Q. ASAK. Main yeh poochna chahta hoon ke "agar ek ladka ladki ek doosre ko pasand karte hain aur ek doosre se yeh kehden ke main apne dil se tumhe biwi manta hoon ya ladki kehde ke main tumhe shauhar maanti hoon" aur "agar phone mien bhi ye iqraar ho ke main allah aur uske farishton ko gawah bana kar main tumse nikah karta hoon aur ladki ya ladkha yeh kehde mujhe qubool hai teen martaba, kahen" to kya nikah hojata hai. Badi saqt zaroorat thi, allah jaza-e-qair de agar mujhe jald-az-jald jawab miljaye. Aise haalat yahan par bahut ho rahe hain. Bahut hi mehebaani hogi. Asak. Jazakallah! 24673 views
answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 4764 Country: United States of America Title: I hope this find you in good health. I had a question about the interpretation of two dreams. I have been doing an Istekhara for a guy whom i would like to marry, but if the answer is negative, May Allah give me the strength to accept it and stay away from anything which is not good for me. In the first dream, There are two groups of people on two pedestals, and the one with the guy is higher, because im looking up at him. One group was wearing black and the other was wearing green, but i dont remember who was wearing what color. In the next dream, my friend and i am sitting in the doctor's office, and this guy comes and asks if he can talk to me, and my friends says no twice, then my friend gets up to talk to the doctor and i say ok i will talk to you, then my friend turns around and tells me she will be having a girl, and i am extremely happy, and me and this guy walk outside, where the sun is very bright. Question: Assalam u Alaikum. I hope this find you in good health. I had a question about the interpretation of two dreams. I have been doing an Istekhara for a guy whom i would like to marry, but if the answer is negative, May Allah give me the strength to accept it and stay away from anything which is not good for me. In the first dream, There are two groups of people on two pedestals, and the one with the guy is higher, because im looking up at him. One group was wearing black and the other was wearing green, but i dont remember who was wearing what color. In the next dream, my friend and i am sitting in the doctor's office, and this guy comes and asks if he can talk to me, and my friends says no twice, then my friend gets up to talk to the doctor and i say ok i will talk to you, then my friend turns around and tells me she will be having a girl, and i am extremely happy, and me and this guy walk outside, where the sun is very bright. Jazakullah Answer ID: 4764 Posted on: Aug 28, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1519/H/1429) If there is no hindrance, you should marry. This seems the result of the dream and istekharah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
